name: homelibrary-manager
description: Desktop application for home library cataloging and reading tracker (Clean Architecture + DDD)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix electron
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
